**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) via `github.com/google/cel-go`; the engine lives at `internal/filter/engine.go`. The CEL expression is compiled to an AST, converted to a dialect-agnostic condition tree (IR in `internal/filter/ir.go`), then rendered to SQL by `internal/filter/render.go` which switches on `DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL` for dialect-specific SQL fragments. Each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, filters, dialect, &where, &args)` from `internal/filter/helpers.go:9`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (explicitly by store code in `store/memo.go:140-158`), plus `memo_share` (via SQL `ON DELETE CASCADE` foreign key), and recursively any comment memos and their relations/attachments (deleted by handler at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`).

**q27.** `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) served via Echo static middleware; `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (lines 20-21 embed, line 42 extracts filesystem, lines 53-59 serve static + SPA fallback)

**q28.**
- S3 Presign Runner — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`), started in `server/server.go:162-170`
- Webhook async workers — 4 goroutines started at `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`, draining a buffered channel

The `memopayload` package (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) has a `Runner` struct with `RunOnce`, but the server does NOT start it as a background runner — it only uses the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function inline during memo create/update in `memo_service.go`.

**q29.** Interceptor at `web/src/connect.ts:156` (`authInterceptor`); it manages access tokens (JWT, short-lived) and refresh tokens (stored in cookies/localStorage) — on 401 it auto-refreshes via `AuthService.RefreshAccessToken`; backend validation in `server/auth/` package (`server/auth/authenticator.go` — `Authenticator` handles access tokens, refresh tokens, and personal access tokens)
